summary: SES S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing an expanded strategic investment and collaboration with Elveo Mobile, created from the Lynk-Omnispace merger. Terms are not disclosed. The collaboration focuses on direct-to-device services, combining SES's GEO/MEO networks with Elveo's LEO network. SES will support Elveo's go-to-market, engineering, operations, and regulatory needs. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing reveals no financial details, stake size, or governance changes. Watch for further announcements on investment terms and regulatory approvals.
